why: The loop the world is authored for: my profile, my posts, the people who reacted, their profiles. compose.mjs rewrites the scrubbed recording from this file; every surface a post is seen on shows the same reactors, and every reactor leads to the profile described here. A post's age (as LinkedIn shows it, 6d, 1w) and impressions are set from here too, so every page agrees: the pages were recorded days apart.

weronika-sadowska-2k7f1.name: Weronika Sadowska
weronika-sadowska-2k7f1.headline: Head of Product at Lantern Analytics · ex-fintech · writes about pricing
weronika-sadowska-2k7f1.about: I run product at Lantern Analytics, a company of forty people that sells one thing well. Before that I spent six years in fintech, mostly on pricing and billing, which taught me that the hardest part of a product is the invoice. I write a short monthly note on pricing decisions and why they go wrong.

igor-baranov-8q3m2.name: Igor Baranov
igor-baranov-8q3m2.headline: Staff Engineer, payments infrastructure · on-call since 2014
igor-baranov-8q3m2.about: I keep payment systems boring. Ten years of ledgers, retries and reconciliation jobs, first at a bank and now at a marketplace. I like small services with clear owners and I distrust any diagram with more than seven boxes. Happy to talk about idempotency keys for longer than is reasonable.

ines-ferreira-5d9x4.name: Inês Ferreira
ines-ferreira-5d9x4.headline: Design Lead at Juniper Studio · design systems for regulated industries
ines-ferreira-5d9x4.about: I lead a team of five designers at Juniper Studio. We build design systems for banks and insurers, where every component has to survive an audit. I care about naming, documentation and the moment a developer stops asking us questions because the system already answers them.

teodor-lis-7w1c9.name: Teodor Lis
teodor-lis-7w1c9.headline: Founder at Beacon Cloud · hiring engineers in Warsaw
teodor-lis-7w1c9.about: Founder of Beacon Cloud, a hosting company for teams that do not want to run Kubernetes themselves. Twelve people, profitable, no investors. I post when we learn something expensive. We are hiring two backend engineers in Warsaw this quarter.
